Due to a regulatory restriction, no direct transit corridor exists between Facility Alpha and Facility Beta.
Furthermore, a specific operational mandate requires that exactly one of the following two key corridors must be incorporated into the inspection loop: the corridor between Facility Beta and Facility Gamma, or the corridor between Facility Gamma and Facility Delta.

The objective is to determine the most efficient closed-loop inspection sequence that visits every facility exactly once and concludes at the initial point of departure.
